info.title: Basstok API
info.description: Basstok's durable external HTTP contract: Content with Comments, Chats with Messages, optional Labels, Members, and Assets. Collection POST creates return Basstok-assigned canonical IDs; item paths address existing resources. Queries filter or page representations. No imported hierarchy, audit mechanics, storage layout, or client framework leaks into this model.

schema.description: Client-generated lowercase UUIDv4; retry an identical batch with the same ID.

put.summary: Schedule a bounded batch of existing API mutations
put.description: Delegated applications only. No separate scheduling scope: every request requires its ordinary write scope. Supports PUT member-creations/{id}, PUT content-drafts/{id}, POST content-drafts/{id}/publish, PUT contents/{id}/comment-creations/{id}, POST chats, and POST chats/{id}/messages under /api/v1/. Chat and Message POSTs require idempotency_key, which supplies their ordinary Idempotency-Key header. No arbitrary headers, hosts, query parameters, edits, nested schedules or other operations. Times use UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ and must be nondecreasing and in the future, with no application-defined future scheduling horizon. The timestamp format supports four-digit years through 9999; a new batch cannot predate its admission's current UTC second. Up to 8192 requests per batch, 16384 retained requests and 32 batches per community, 64 KiB per body, and 16 MiB total request data. Each exact request is authorized against the current Grant, responsible Member, persona and resource. Unrelated scope or Label additions do not invalidate execution. Stored admission snapshots never confer authority. Identical submission retries return current progress; changing a running batch returns 409. Pause the batch to replace its unattempted tail with future requests under the same ID. The exact completed prefix and any currently attempted request, including its time, are immutable. Replacement keeps the batch paused and does not reset attempts. Completed records retain identity for at least seven days from actual completion; cancelled records from cancellation.

200.description: Durably accepted, or identical retry with current progress.

get.summary: Inspect this Grant's scheduled batch and progress
get.description: Only the current delegated Grant that submitted the batch can inspect it. Results are in submission order. Earlier failed items do not roll back successful requests or create dependencies; remaining items execute normally. Retryable outcomes use bounded backoff and at most 16 attempts. A terminal error is not a promise that an earlier ambiguous attempt never committed. Creation identities prevent duplicating the underlying creation on recovery. Exact execution time is not guaranteed; requests are never intentionally executed before their due time.

delete.summary: Cancel pending requests in this Grant's batch
delete.description: Idempotent cancellation. An already admitted request may finish. Completed work is not undone. The cancelled batch remains inspectable during retention.

get.summary: List official Agents and current connection status
get.description: Current human Managers only. Offline Agents remain visible; enabled Agents can still be disabled.

200.description: Current catalog and exact permissions for native consent.

403.description: A current human Manager is required. Delegated application tokens are not accepted.

503.description: Temporarily unavailable; refresh status before retrying.

put.summary: Enable or disable an official Agent
put.description: Requires a current human Manager bearer session. Enabling explicitly consents to the exact scope and Content Label shown by the catalog. OAuth authorization-code/PKCE and ordinary revocable delegation remain in use. Disabling stops future automation without undoing previous actions. Exact repeats are safe; after a failed or ambiguous response re-read the catalog before retrying.

403.description: A current human Manager is required. Delegated application tokens are not accepted.

409.description: Permissions changed. Fetch the catalog and obtain fresh consent.

503.description: Temporarily unavailable; refresh status before retrying.

put.description: Requires the current human Manager who owns the import. Delegated application tokens are rejected. The hostname selects the Organization. Import authority does not permit reading private Chats without ordinary participation. Exact retries return current progress; changing an admitted declaration is a conflict. At most 128 imports per Organization.

get.description: Requires the current human Manager who owns the import. Delegated application tokens are rejected. The hostname selects the Organization. Import authority does not permit reading private Chats without ordinary participation.

put.description: Requires the current human Manager who owns the import. Delegated application tokens are rejected. The hostname selects the Organization. Import authority does not permit reading private Chats without ordinary participation. Bodies are at most 64 MiB. Source parts come first, each 16 MiB except the last, and must match the declared whole-file digest. The final batch is report. JSON kind-to-schema: labels=Label[], members=HistoricalMembers, stage-content/publish-content=HistoricalContentBatch, stage-chats/publish-chats=HistoricalChatBatch, asset=HistoricalAsset, routes=HistoricalRoute[], report=ImportTransformReport. Stage owning resources before their Assets; publish the identical resource facts afterward. The digest chain starts with 64 ASCII zeroes; each step is lowercase SHA256(previous_chain + ':' + kind + ':' + lowercase SHA256(exact_body)). Only exact pending requests may be retried. Earlier tasks can remain published on failure; whole-migration atomicity is not claimed.

post.description: Requires the current human Manager who owns the import. Delegated application tokens are rejected. The hostname selects the Organization. Import authority does not permit reading private Chats without ordinary participation. Requires all declared batches and the verified recipe digest. An exact repeated completion is safe.

get.description: Reads the current Organization only when the authenticated Member may manage it. Returns the same public Organization fields as getOrganization; no storage credentials or operational details. Returns 403 when management authority is absent or revoked.

Current human Managers only. Returns the customer-selected target when customer-managed storage is in use. Never returns credentials or details of Basstok-managed storage. Delegated application tokens are not accepted.

401.description: The Member session is invalid or revoked.

403.description: Current human Manager authority is required.

post.summary: Check S3 settings without changing community storage
post.description: Current human Managers only. Checks the supplied HTTPS target and credentials using bounded temporary objects and multipart uploads, then removes those probes. Does not retain the submitted credentials, select the bucket or move community data. A target other than the currently enrolled target must be empty and dedicated to this community. The endpoint must be a public HTTPS origin without a path, query, fragment or embedded credentials. Customer lifecycle rules and browser CORS rules are not read, changed or verified. A successful check is not authorization to use the bucket and does not guarantee its future availability. Exact repeated checks are safe. Request JSON is limited to 32 KiB; secrets and provider diagnostics are never echoed in an error response.

200.description: Required data operations passed and the temporary probes were removed

400.description: Invalid target, credential fields or request body, including JSON exceeding 32 KiB; correct the settings before retrying.

401.description: The Member session is invalid or revoked.

403.description: Current human Manager authority is required, including when verification finishes.

502.description: Verification could not complete. Check the target, credentials, required operations and reachability before retrying.

post.summary: Move community data to a customer-owned bucket
post.description: Current human Managers only. Checks a dedicated empty S3-compatible bucket, then durably starts a transfer. Ordinary community activity pauses while data moves; unfinished uploads may need to be started again. The operation continues independently of the requesting client and resumes after a service restart. Credentials are retained privately for the connection and are never returned. GET organization/storage reports progress and the completed selection. Exact repeated requests are safe; a different pending or active connection returns 409. This operation moves Basstok-managed data to a customer-owned bucket; it does not replace an already connected customer bucket. Request JSON is limited to 32 KiB.

200.description: The exact connection is already active

202.description: Transfer admitted; read storage status for progress

400.description: Invalid target, credentials or request body.

401.description: The Member session is invalid or revoked.

403.description: Current human Manager authority is required.

409.description: A different connection already exists or a storage operation is already running. Read storage status before retrying.

502.description: The storage operation could not complete. Read storage status before retrying; an admitted transfer remains resumable.

post.description: Current human Managers only. Uses the already admitted connection; send an empty request body. Does not replace its target or credentials. A transfer already running returns 409; an already completed transfer returns 200. Failed transfers remain paused until their connection can be used again.

400.description: There is no admitted connection, or the request body is not empty.

401.description: The Member session is invalid or revoked.

403.description: Current human Manager authority is required.

409.description: The storage operation is already running; read storage status.

put.description: Applies one fixed Basstok audience Label to the Organization, or makes the Organization public when label is null.

get.description: Resolve one public URI path to its canonical Basstok resource. Imported paths may include source-compatible title variants; manager-chosen paths use exact matching.

200.description: The requested resolved path and its canonical target

put.description: Assign an exact public URI path to an existing canonical resource. Requires Organization management access. Reusing a path is idempotent only when its target and pagination semantics are unchanged.

delete.description: Remove one exact public URI assignment. Requires Organization management access and is idempotent when the path is already unassigned.

204.description: The exact public route is unassigned

put.description: Atomically applies one bounded standalone Organization website from canonical Content, Assets, and Route Aliases. An exact declaration with empty contents, assets, and navigation removes the active Website. The declaration is request input only; Basstok does not retain or read a client filesystem path. Repeating the same desired state is idempotent.

200.description: The requested Website publication is active, or the Website is absent after an empty declaration

202.description: Magic-link request accepted; a development loopback response may also include the token

get.description: Returns the responsible Member identity for the current Member session or delegated OAuth grant.

delete.description: Records a deletion request and revokes authentication. Shared records and moderation evidence follow the published retention policy.

get.description: Lists the bounded open report queue for authorized moderators. Resolved reports are excluded.

put.description: Creates Content as one complete retry-safe operation, repeats an exact create across an interrupted staged-create boundary, or replaces selected-Label Content. Replacing an already-published Content resource requires content:write and the responsible Member's current ordinary moderation authority. moderation:write alone never permits title, body, Label, Asset, or engagement replacement.

200.description: Updated Content when the caller also has current Content read access; otherwise an ID-only mutation acknowledgement

delete.description: Remove dependency-free Content. Requires Organization management access and is idempotent after the Content is absent.

409.description: The Content still owns or carries dependent state

put.description: Applies one fixed Basstok moderation Label, or removes the current moderation Label when label is null.

200.description: Updated Content when the caller also has current read access; otherwise an ID-only mutation acknowledgement

put.description: Applies one fixed Basstok audience Label, or clears the local Content audience so it inherits the Organization audience when label is null.

200.description: Updated Content when the caller also has current read access; otherwise an ID-only mutation acknowledgement
Updated Content when the caller also has current read access; otherwise an ID-only mutation acknowledgement
Updated Content when the caller also has current read access; otherwise an ID-only mutation acknowledgement

put.description: Creates a Comment or repeats the same creation with content:read and content:write. Changing an existing Comment additionally requires current moderation authority. Returns the Comment only while the caller retains current Content read access.

200.description: Created or updated Comment when the caller also has current Content read access; otherwise an ID-only mutation acknowledgement

put.description: Creates one Comment for this application, responsible human Member, and selected visible author, or returns the unchanged result of an exact retry. An existing Comment from another application, responsible Member, or visible author, a different placement or payload, or a subsequently changed Comment produces a non-retryable conflict and is never updated.

200.description: Created Comment or exact retry when the caller also retains current Content read access; otherwise an ID-only mutation acknowledgement

409.description: The Comment identity belongs to another creation or no longer matches the original creation

put.description: Applies one fixed Basstok moderation Label, or removes the current moderation Label when label is null.

200.description: Updated Comment when the caller also has current Content read access; otherwise an ID-only mutation acknowledgement
Updated Content draft when the caller also has current Content read access; otherwise an ID-only mutation acknowledgement

post.description: Creates an Asset of at most 8 MiB in the exact pending Content create owned by this caller and returns its Basstok-assigned opaque identity. Delegated callers require content:write, the same current Grant and responsible Member that began the draft, and a Content Label set still covered by that Grant. Retry an ambiguous outcome with the exact same Idempotency-Key, metadata, and bytes; changed input with the same key conflicts.

200.description: Created Asset metadata or exact retry
Published Content when the caller also has current Content read access; otherwise an ID-only mutation acknowledgement

get.description: Returns subscription status for the responsible Member by default. Supplying actor_id selects an existing no-login Member controlled by this exact application for the same responsible human Member.

put.description: Subscribes the responsible Member by default. Supplying actor_id selects a no-login Member created and still controlled by this exact application for the same responsible human Member.

delete.description: Removes the responsible Member's subscription by default. Supplying actor_id selects a no-login Member created and still controlled by this exact application for the same responsible human Member.

get.description: Lists the no-login Members created by this exact application grant's responsible human Member. This OAuth-only discovery endpoint does not expose Members controlled by another application or another responsible Member. next_offset is an opaque continuation for the same grant context.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Opaque canonical Member inventory scan continuation.

200.description: Controlled Members visible under the current delegation

Cache-Control.description: Controlled-Member discovery is authorization-scoped and must not be reused from an HTTP cache.

get.description: Search visible Member display names for Chat participant discovery. Results are discovery hints only; new Chat admission revalidates current participant availability and authorization. next_offset is an opaque continuation for the same query and authorization context, not a result count.

Cache-Control.description: Member discovery is authorization-scoped and must not be reused from an HTTP cache.

409.description: The bounded Member-search snapshot changed while it was being hydrated. Retry the same request after the advertised delay.

error.message: Member search state changed; retry the request.

200.description: Connection between the current Member and the specified Member

put.description: Creates one no-login Member for this application and responsible human Member, or returns the unchanged result of an exact retry. An existing human Member, another application's Member, a different responsible Member, or changed profile data produces a non-retryable conflict and is never updated.

200.description: Created Member or exact retry when the caller also has current Member read access; otherwise an ID-only mutation acknowledgement

put.description: Creates or updates a Member. A delegated create produces a no-login persona controlled by the application, records the responsible human Member, and requires that human to retain Manager authority.

200.description: Created or updated Member when the caller also has current Member read access; otherwise an ID-only mutation acknowledgement

put.description: Applies one fixed Basstok role Label, or restores the ordinary Member role when label is null.

200.description: Updated Member when the caller also has current Member read access; otherwise an ID-only mutation acknowledgement
Updated Member when the caller also has current Member read access; otherwise an ID-only mutation acknowledgement

get.description: Lists only Chats visible to the effective participant. actor_id may select a no-login Member created and controlled by this application; that Member's own Chat admission boundary applies.

post.description: Creates a Chat with a Basstok-assigned opaque identity. creator_id may select a no-login Member created and controlled by this application and that Member must be among the participants. Exactly two initial participants identify one titleless direct Chat. Retry an ambiguous outcome with the exact same Idempotency-Key and body; a changed body with the same key conflicts.

200.description: Created Chat, exact retry, or existing direct Chat for the unordered participant pair

schema.description: The authorized Chat representation when the caller also has chat:read, otherwise its canonical identity only.

get.description: Returns a Chat only when the effective participant is admitted. actor_id may select a no-login Member created and controlled by this application; activity from before that Member's admission is omitted.

post.description: Emits a short-lived process-local typing pulse for the authenticated Chat participant. The empty-body request makes no canonical mutation; the hint is delivered through the existing Chat-scoped GET /api/v1/events?chat_id={chatId} SSE stream and may be dropped.

put.description: Adds one Member to a Chat managed by the effective participant. The new participant can observe only Chat activity, Messages, and Assets shared from its admission boundary forward. Repeating the same addition is idempotent.

200.description: Updated Chat when the caller also has chat:read

204.description: Participant added; no Chat representation was disclosed

put.description: Attaches an already uploaded Chat-owned Asset to a Chat available to the effective participant.

delete.description: Detaches a Chat-owned Asset from a Chat managed by the effective participant.

get.description: Lists only Messages at or after the effective participant's Chat admission boundary.

post.description: Sends a Message with a Basstok-assigned opaque identity to a Chat available to the visible author. Supplying author_id selects a controlled no-login Member that must be admitted to the Chat. Retry an ambiguous outcome with the exact same Idempotency-Key and body; a changed body with the same key conflicts.

get.description: Returns the Message only when it is at or after the effective participant's Chat admission boundary. An inaccessible or unknown Message is not disclosed.

post.description: Creates an Asset of at most 8 MiB under one authorized Organization, Content, or Chat parent and returns its Basstok-assigned opaque identity. OAuth callers use an explicit Content or Chat parent. A Chat upload remains visible only to its uploader until shared through a Message or attachment to the Chat; other participants then require visibility of that shared activity from their admission boundary. Retry an ambiguous outcome with the exact same Idempotency-Key, query parameters, and bytes; changed input with the same key conflicts.

200.description: Created Asset metadata or exact retry

get.description: Returns an authorized Asset payload or metadata. For a Chat-owned Asset, chat:read and effective-participant access from that Member's admission boundary are both required; actor_id may select an existing controlled Member. Payload responses include a strong ETag. Anonymous payloads use private, no-cache, must-revalidate; authenticated payloads use no-store. Asset URLs are not immutable. Conditional payload requests always evaluate current authorization before returning bytes or 304. Metadata responses are not conditional.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Payload only: one or more entity-tags, or *. A matching current representation returns 304 after authorization. Weak comparison applies; this condition precedes Range.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Payload only: require a matching strong entity-tag or *. A mismatch returns 412. Evaluated before If-None-Match.

parameters.name: If-Range
parameters.description: Payload only: apply Range only if this is the exact current strong ETag; otherwise return the complete payload. Dates and weak validators do not match.

200.description: Authorized Asset payload, or exact Asset metadata when metadata=1

ETag.description: Strong payload validator; absent for metadata.

Cache-Control.description: private, no-cache, must-revalidate for anonymous payloads; no-store for authenticated requests or metadata.

ETag.description: Strong validator for the complete payload.

Content-Range.description: Selected byte interval and complete payload size.

Cache-Control.description: Same policy as the complete payload response.

304.description: The currently authorized payload matches If-None-Match. No response body.

Cache-Control.description: Same policy as the complete payload response.

post.description: Begins a bounded Content- or Chat-owned multipart Asset upload and returns Basstok-assigned opaque upload and Asset identities. content:write is sufficient only for an exact pending Content create owned by the same application and responsible Member; an existing published Content additionally requires content:read and ordinary resource authorization. For a Chat parent, actor_id selects the effective participant and the same value must be supplied for every later operation on this upload. Retry an ambiguous begin with the exact same Idempotency-Key and declaration; changed input with the same key conflicts.

put.description: Writes one bounded upload part after rechecking the same parent access used to begin the upload. A published Content parent additionally requires content:read. Supply the same actor_id used to begin a controlled-Member Chat upload.

post.description: Completes the Asset after validating all declared bytes and integrity metadata and rechecking parent access. A published Content parent additionally requires content:read. Supply the same actor_id used to begin a controlled-Member Chat upload.

delete.description: Aborts the upload after rechecking parent access. A published Content parent additionally requires content:read. Supply the same actor_id used to begin a controlled-Member Chat upload.

put.description: Sets the responsible Member's Reaction by default. Supplying actor_id selects a no-login Member created and still controlled by this exact application for the same responsible human Member.

delete.description: Removes the responsible Member's Reaction by default. Supplying actor_id selects a no-login Member created and still controlled by this exact application for the same responsible human Member.

get.description: Bounded foreground delivery of committed freshness signals and short-lived process-local typing hints. Anonymous callers may select only currently public Content; non-public Content remains unavailable. OAuth callers may select only a Content covered by content:read or a participant Chat covered by chat:read; actor_id selects an existing controlled Member for a Chat stream and applies that Member's admission boundary. Chat streams require ordinary participant access, and Member inbox events remain Member-session-only. Re-read referenced canonical resources for committed state; events are not canonical truth or history, and typing hints may be missed or lost on restart.
Lists the Member's bounded current call invitations and participation state. Calls and signaling are ephemeral; media is peer to peer.

post.description: Starts an audio or video call in an existing Chat. Each endpoint declares the outbound bandwidth available for the full mesh.

200.description: Current call state and this Member's pairwise signals

post.description: Sends one bounded WebRTC offer, answer, or ICE candidate to one joined peer. SSE is the wake-up signal; re-read the Call for current state.

put.description: Accepts, declines, or stops endpoint-local recording. Recording starts only after every joined participant accepts.

post.description: Creates a short-lived direct multipart Object Storage upload during this unanimously consented Call recording session's bounded recovery window.
Verifies the direct upload's complete size and SHA-256, then records it as an authorized Chat Asset.

get.description: Lists subscriptions visible to the caller. Signing secrets are never included in list responses.

put.description: The signing secret is returned only by the successful write. Webhook endpoints require HTTPS and must resolve entirely to public network addresses; redirects are not followed.

200.description: The active subscription, including its signing secret

delete.description: A Member may revoke an authorized grant. An OAuth client may revoke only its own current grant. Once the revocation succeeds, subsequent authentication and webhook delivery for that Grant are denied.

get.description: Presents Member consent for an authorization code with mandatory PKCE S256. The Member must have an active Basstok browser session and its matching browser-presence cookie.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Space-delimited delegated capability names requested from the application's allowed scopes.

post.description: Accepts the consent decision from the Basstok authorization page. The csrf value must match the browser-presence cookie for the active Member session.

Exchanges an authorization code using mandatory PKCE S256, or rotates a refresh token. A successful refresh returns replacement access and refresh tokens; replace the stored pair atomically. Reuse of the previous rotated refresh token revokes the complete Application Grant.

Revokes the complete Application Grant represented by a known access or refresh token, including its credentials and webhook delivery. The response does not reveal whether the token was known. Once a successful response is returned for a known token, subsequent access is denied.

put.description: Replaces the ordinary Labels selecting Content resources available to the grant. The responsible Member must authorize this change.

schema.description: Client-generated lowercase UUIDv4; retry an identical batch with the same ID.

post.summary: Pause pending requests in this Grant's batch
post.description: Durably pause pending requests without cancelling the batch. Idempotent. An already admitted request may finish and record its result. Paused batches survive restart and remain until resumed or cancelled; completed-record retention does not apply. Requires the submitting current delegated Grant.

schema.description: Client-generated lowercase UUIDv4; retry an identical batch with the same ID.

post.description: Clear a durable pause. Overdue requests become eligible immediately in their original order with current authorization. Attempts and retry budget are not reset. Idempotent; cancelled batches return 409, completed batches remain complete. Requires the submitting current delegated Grant.

memberSessionCookie.name: __Host-basstok-session
memberSessionCookie.description: The active Member browser session used by the authorization page.

browserPresenceCookie.name: __Host-basstok-presence
browserPresenceCookie.description: The browser-presence companion for the active Member session.

scopes.content:read: Read Content and Comments carrying selected Labels.
scopes.content:write: Create Content and Comments carrying selected Labels; this does not permit reads.
scopes.engagement:write: React to and subscribe to Content carrying selected Labels, when combined with content:read.
scopes.member:read: Read and search Members visible to the responsible Member.
scopes.member:write: Create no-login persona Members and perform Manager-authorized Member mutations.
scopes.chat:read: Read Chats, Messages, and Chat Assets available to the effective participant from that Member's admission boundary; this does not permit writes.
scopes.chat:write: Create Chats, add participants, and send Messages or Chat Assets where the effective participant may do so; this does not grant Chat history reads.
scopes.moderation:write: Moderate Content and Comments carrying selected Labels.

SearchOffset.name: offset
SearchOffset.description: Opaque canonical scan continuation. Start with 0 and reuse a returned SearchPage next_offset only with the same query and authorization context.

PublicPath.name: path
PublicPath.description: Exact absolute URI path, beginning with /. Query strings and fragments are not part of a route.

MemberSearchQuery.name: q
MemberSearchQuery.description: After trimming surrounding whitespace, the query must contain 1 to 256 meaningful UTF-8 bytes.

MemberSearchOffset.name: offset
MemberSearchOffset.description: Opaque canonical Member inventory scan continuation. Reuse it only with the same query and authorization context.

EventCursor.name: cursor
EventCursor.description: Opaque process-local continuation for exactly the same Organization and selected Content, Chat, or Member resource. Do not reuse it for another resource. A reset response replaces an obsolete cursor.

ActorQuery.name: actor_id
ActorQuery.description: Selects a no-login Member created and still controlled by this exact application for its responsible human Member. The operation's ordinary scopes still apply; selecting an existing controlled Member does not require member:write.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: A lowercase RFC 4122 UUIDv4 identifying this create operation. Reuse it only to retry the exact same operation; Basstok assigns the canonical resource identity.

Error.description: Stable API error envelope. HTTP status and error.code remain distinguishable; retryable states whether the same request may succeed later.

path.description: An exact supported /api/v1/ mutation path, without host or query parameters.

body.description: The ordinary endpoint's JSON request body; omit for Content publication.

idempotency_key.description: Required only for Chat and Message creation; supplies the ordinary Idempotency-Key header.

resource_id.description: The ordinary mutation's returned resource identity, when available. No response body is retained.

attempts.description: Attempts admitted for the next unfinished request.

paused_at.description: Present while pending work is paused. An admitted request may still finish.

scope.description: Exact space-separated OAuth scopes to echo when enabling.

content_label_id.description: Exact selected ordinary Label identity, or empty when not applicable.

welcome_message.description: Welcome guide only: the current installation message, or the suggested message before installation. Uninstall and reinstall to change an installed message.

Welcome guide installation only: nonblank Markdown, at most 2048 UTF-8 bytes. Omit to use the suggested welcome. The instruction stays fixed for this installation so delivery retries cannot change their message.

source_system.description: Source dialect name for provenance, not a server parser selector. Name plus import ID plus three separator characters must fit 128 characters.

source_name.description: Original file name without directory separators or control characters.

ImportReceipt.description: Immutable declaration and current sequential progress. A pending fingerprint binds the exact request across interruption; only a successful task advances next_batch. Completed means the complete declared recipe and transformation report were committed.

HistoricalContent.description: Historical Content facts. Supply canonical identities and CommonMark text where applicable. Execution attribution is assigned by Basstok, not supplied by the importer.

HistoricalComment.description: Historical Comment facts. Supply canonical identities and CommonMark text where applicable. Execution attribution is assigned by Basstok, not supplied by the importer.

description.description: Optional public CommonMark profile text, limited to 4096 UTF-8 bytes.

HistoricalMember.description: Historical Member facts. Supply canonical identities and CommonMark text where applicable. Execution attribution is assigned by Basstok, not supplied by the importer.

HistoricalMessage.description: Historical Message facts. Supply canonical identities and CommonMark text where applicable. Execution attribution is assigned by Basstok, not supplied by the importer.

created_by_member_id.description: The creating Member when creation is within the caller's Chat visibility boundary. Omitted for a participant admitted later.

HistoricalChat.description: Historical Chat facts. Supply canonical identities and CommonMark text where applicable. Execution attribution is assigned by Basstok, not supplied by the importer.

HistoricalMembers.description: Historical Member identities with optional account emails. No credentials, Agent control, Basstok terms consent, blocks, deletion requests or notification preferences may be imported.

title_identity_segment.description: Optional zero-based segment where an imported numeric identity accepts an arbitrary legacy title prefix. The stored segment contains the numeric identity alone.

HistoricalRoute.description: An exact legacy public route. Page offsets, page size and Comment targets preserve pagination and deep links. System-owned routes and Website ownership are not importable.

href.description: A published site route, optionally with a query or fragment, or /community.

content_id.description: Publication-local identity of the owning Content.

payload_base64.description: Canonical padded base64 for an Asset of at most 8 MiB.

route.description: Primary canonical public path for this Website Content.

aliases.description: Additional public paths for the same canonical Website Content. Primary routes and aliases are globally unique and total at most 64 per publication.

body.description: CommonMark Markdown source. Active HTML is not accepted or rendered. Website authoring may reference an Asset owned by this Content with an asset:publication-local-id link or image destination; publication resolves it to the ordinary Asset URL. Unknown or unowned references are rejected.

WebsitePublication.description: Bounded desired Website state. Empty contents removes the active Website and requires assets and navigation to be empty.

publication_id.description: Stable digest identity of the complete declaration and Asset bytes.

contents.description: Website Content declarations. An empty array requests Website removal and is valid only with empty assets and navigation.

changed.description: False when this exact publication was already active or an empty declaration found the Website already absent.

PublicRouteTarget.description: Canonical resource reached by a public path. Comment targets include their owning Content ID. Chat routes remain participant-authorized.

content_id.description: Owning Content ID; present only for a Comment target.

content_offset.description: Imported Content-page offset; valid only for a Label route.

comment_offset.description: Imported Comment-page offset; valid only for a Content route.

page_size.description: Imported page size for a pageable Label or Content route.

OrganizationStorage.description: Target is present for transferring and customer_owned custody. Transfer counters are present only while transferring and report copied data, not a completion percentage. Credentials are never returned.

endpoint.description: Public HTTPS origin without a trailing slash, path, query, fragment or embedded credentials.

bucket.description: Dedicated private S3 bucket; adjacent periods, period-hyphen combinations and IPv4-address names are rejected.

Authorship.description: Public attribution committed with its owning Content or Comment. Linked authorship carries a stable Member identity and the event-time display-name snapshot; the snapshot does not grant access to the Member profile.

display_name.description: Event-time public attribution label for linked authorship, or the retained source label for an unlinked imported author.

OrganizationSystemLabels.description: The Organization's optional fixed audience Label. At most one audience may be present.

MemberSystemLabels.description: Fixed Member state: independent supporter status and at most one authority role.

ContentSystemLabels.description: Fixed Content state: at most one audience and one moderation state, plus independent reply and featured state.

CommentSystemLabels.description: The Comment's optional fixed moderation state. At most one moderation state may be present.

comment_count.description: Visible Comments in this collection presentation; derived from the owning Content aggregate.

ContentSummary.description: Bounded collection presentation; retrieve the independently addressed Content resource for its complete body.

title.description: Optional authored title. Omit it or use an empty string for an untitled post; replacement omission removes the title. Basstok does not generate a stored title. Published Content requires nonempty title, body, or at least one attachment.

audience.description: Optional audience for initial Content creation. Existing Content audience changes use the dedicated audience operation.

parent_id.description: Owning parent Comment identity. Omit or use null for a root Comment. Replacement cannot change existing placement.

avatar.description: An authorized image Asset owned by this community. Omit to preserve the current avatar, or use null to remove it. Other resources’ attachments cannot be used as avatars.

created_by_member_id.description: The creating Member when creation is within the caller's Chat visibility boundary. Omitted for a participant admitted later.

creator_id.description: Optional no-login persona Member created and still controlled by this application for the responsible human Member. The selected creator must be included in participant_ids. Selecting an existing controlled Member does not require member:write.

method.description: Dynamic uploads begin at initiation_url; presigned uploads use the ordered part_urls followed by completion_url, with abort_url used after failure.

WebhookSubscription.description: A Webhook Subscription representation returned by list operations. Signing secrets are never included.

WebhookSubscriptionCreated.description: The Webhook Subscription representation returned only by a successful create or replace operation. Store the signing secret securely; list operations never return it.

signing_secret.description: The HMAC-SHA256 secret for this subscription. It is returned by this write response and omitted from every list response.

content_label_ids.description: Ordinary Label identities selecting the Content resources available to this grant.

scope.description: Space-delimited delegated capability names approved by the Member.

csrf.description: The value of the matching browser-presence cookie.

access_token.description: A short-lived bearer token for this Application Grant.

refresh_token.description: The current rotating refresh token. After every successful refresh, atomically replace the previous token with this value; replaying the previous token revokes the complete Grant.

grant_id.description: The current Application Grant identity used when registering webhooks.

actor_id.description: Present for a Chat reference delivered for a selected controlled Member. Use the same actor_id when dereferencing the Chat so its participant and admission boundary are applied.

WebhookPayload.description: A signed, reference-only notification with no Content or Message body, Member profile description, or Asset bytes. Fetch the referenced resource through the REST API to obtain its current authorized representation.

next_offset.description: Opaque canonical Member inventory scan continuation. Reuse it only with the same query and authorization context. A page with no items may still carry next_offset; omission means the scan is complete.

post.description:
Bounded signed change signal. Require the Basstok-Webhook-Id header to equal payload.id and Basstok-Webhook-Timestamp to equal payload.occurred_at. Verify Basstok-Webhook-Signature as lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 using the subscription signing secret over the exact UTF-8 bytes `v1
<delivery-id>
<timestamp>
<body>`, where body is the request body exactly as received. Deduplicate by delivery ID, then re-read authorized current state.

2XX.description: Any 2xx response, including 204 No Content, accepts and settles the delivery
